final_text:
Of the 10 organisms spiked into P0, 5 are detected and 5 are missed. I counted an organism as detected if its species-level (rank S) clade read count was at least 10.

| Organism | Species clade reads | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Enterococcus faecalis | 6457 | detected |
| Pseudomonas aeruginosa | 811 | detected |
| Escherichia coli | 72 | detected |
| Staphylococcus aureus | 54 | detected |
| Lactobacillus fermentum (reported as Limosilactobacillus fermentum) | 26 | detected |
| Salmonella enterica | 4 | missed |
| Bacillus subtilis | 2 | missed |
| Listeria monocytogenes | no species row | missed |
| Saccharomyces cerevisiae | not in report | missed |
| Cryptococcus neoformans | not in report | missed |

For Listeria monocytogenes, the report has a Listeria genus row with 315 reads but no species-level row. Those reads don't count under the species-level rule.
